description: Repository-local Renovate overrides for xinyi-relay. Both rules below are repository-specific: the rustls coordinate lives in this project's own Maven package registry and its release axis is upstream's git tags, so they belong next to settings.gradle.kts and scripts/ci/rustls_pv_publish.sh rather than in the shared toolkit preset. Keep the shared policy in gitlab>magisk3171/shared/magisk-ci-toolkit.

packageRules.description: rustls:rustls-platform-verifier is built from upstream source by scripts/ci/rustls_pv_publish.sh and PUT into this project's package registry; it never lands on Maven Central, so the Central-only lookup reports no-result.

customManagers.description: Track the rustls-platform-verifier AAR on the axis that actually decides it: upstream releases are tagged v/<version>, the exact ref rustls_pv_publish.sh clones. The built-in gradle manager keeps checking the registry, which only ever lists what we already published.
